sources.title: Available models | Cursor Docs
sources.snippet: Available models Cursor supports a range of AI models from multiple providers. How do I switch models? Open the model selector in your chat or agent panel and choose the model you want, or press CmdCtrl + / to cycle through models. Your selection persists across conversations until you change it.
